_comment_accounting_donations: Donations for the accounting add-on (D-036; docs/guides/donations-guide.md is the source of truth). Merged into the site's configuration only while ngdpbase.addons.accounting-donations.enabled is true. It needs the accounting add-on, whose managers it calls; it keeps no database of its own for gifts.
_comment_categories: Chart codes a gift may be recorded under: donation categories in the accounting chart (docs/guides/chart-of-accounts-guide.md). A list, so a site's value replaces this one.
_comment_wording: The receipt slip's quid pro quo disclosure and the year-end statement's wording (IRS Publication 1771). {amount}, {deductible}, {goods}, {value}, {organization}, {year} and {taxId} are filled in. The organization checks the wording with its accountant.

ngdpbase.addons.accounting-donations.wor.quid-pro-quo: Of your gift of {amount}, {deductible} is deductible for federal income tax purposes. You received {goods}, valued at {value}.
ngdpbase.addons.accounting-donations.wor.statement-intro: Thank you for your support of {organization}. This statement lists your contributions received in {year}.
ngdpbase.addons.accounting-donations.wor.no-goods: No goods or services were provided in exchange for these contributions.
ngdpbase.addons.accounting-donations.wor.goods-note: Where goods or services were provided in exchange for a contribution, their value is shown, and only the amount above it is deductible.
ngdpbase.addons.accounting-donations.wor.tax-id: {organization} is a tax-exempt organization. Its federal tax identification number is {taxId}.

_comment_database: Donations' own database (operator, 2026-10-20): in-kind gifts and pledges. Never the accounting add-on's database. encrypt 'optional': SQLCipher when NGDPBASE_DATABASE_KEY is set.

donation-record.description: Record in-kind gifts and pledges, and void or cancel them

audit.description: In-kind gift or pledge recorded, voided or cancelled

statement-issue.description: Issue, reissue and email year-end giving statements

audit.description: Giving statements issued, reissued or emailed

ngdpbase.access.policies.name: Treasurer keeps the donations
ngdpbase.access.policies.description: The treasurer role records in-kind gifts and pledges, finds donors and adds new ones (core's contacts, ngdpbase #1930). Recording gifts of money is the accounting add-on's ledger-record.

_comment_organization: Who the giving statements are from: the organization's name, its federal tax ID (EIN) and postal address, printed on every statement.
